name: CM Performing Arts Center

evidence.note: Theater description says it seats 330, including a VIP section of raised banquet seats.
Venue page for The Soul Jam Revue (Oct 4, 7 PM) offers cabaret-style VIP seating with table service.
Reviews talk about plays, candlelight concerts and comfortable seating; none mention dancing.

dancing.notes: The theater has rows of seats plus a raised VIP section with cabaret tables, and we found no dance floor. Concert ads say the music makes you want to dance, but expect a seated show.

description: A nonprofit community theater of about 330 seats on Montauk Highway in Oakdale. It stages musicals and also hosts tribute concerts, comedy and candlelight shows.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Same place as Ira's 'CMPAC'. The Oct 4 show is The Soul Jam Revue, a Philly soul tribute concert.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description still accurate. The theater is in the Lighthouse Commons shopping center. Logo file is the version made for dark backgrounds (white and gold letters on transparent). Photo 3 is a smaller rental room shown on the venue rentals page.

Parking and access research 2026-10-06 (issue #40): parking and accessibility added from the theater's own visit and accessibility pages. The main stage is the Noel S. Ruiz Theatre (311 seats plus cabaret tables, rental page); the All Revved Up NY show on Oct 15, 2026 is there.
hours: Box office Mon-Fri 10 AM-6 PM; Sat 10 AM-3 PM; Sun closed except show days; opens 2 hours before every show

logo.alt: CM Performing Arts Center logo: 'CM' between gold stage curtains, with 'Performing Arts Center' in white and gold script

evidence.note: Theater's own contact page: 931 Montauk Highway, Oakdale, NY 11769; (631) 218-2810; info@cmpac.com; box office hours Mon-Fri 10-6, Sat 10-3, Sun closed except show days.

Site header and footer link Facebook (cmpac), Instagram (cmperformingarts), TikTok (@cmperformingarts), X (cmpac) and YouTube (@CMPerformingArtsCenterOakdale); menu lists cover band concerts and a Cover Band Pass.
Google Maps: CM Performing Arts Center (performing arts theater) at 931 Montauk Hwy, Oakdale, NY 11769, in Lighthouse Commons; phone (631) 218-2810.
Visit page: plenty of parking in Lighthouse Commons; use marked spaces and follow store signs. The lobby opens 1 hour before shows.
Accessibility page: ADA design, accessible entrances and exits, an accessible stall in each restroom, wheelchair and companion seats, 7 van-accessible spaces.

parkingNotes: Free parking in the large lot of the Lighthouse Commons shopping center, where the theater is. Use marked spaces, not the fire lane, and watch for signs that save spots in front of some stores.
accessibilityNotes: The theater says it is built to ADA rules: all entrances and exits are accessible, there are 7 van-accessible parking spaces near the street-level main doors, each restroom has an accessible stall, and there is wheelchair seating with a companion seat and no steps to reach it.
